remarks_post_1999: The Lynes publication listed the date for the original design as 1916, this has been confirmed as an editorial mistake and the record has been updated to the correct designed date of 1946. (Source: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum, 2026)

Lynes, 1999 lists medium as Wax. Conservation research shows it is an incomplete epoxy resin maquette, marked in graphite for points of enlargement, with a section of the outer loop broken and missing, measuring 9 3/4" high, x 9 1/2" at the break in the elevated loop x 4 3/4" deep at the base. The elevated loop angle and location and the base appear to be an earlier version of the current bronze castings, with a different initial angle and base shape. (Source: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum, 2026)
